capacity: No fitted parameters or validation convergence. Priors, complete response library and noise laws are supplied.
cue_contrasts: Every reader has strong-minus-weak contrasts at every budget, separately with omission absent/present.
duplicate_removal: Fourth offered successor aliases the base. It adds no probability mass; planner never selects it, while four-slot fixed expansion pays for it. This is not a product-of-features ablation.
execution_shift: Unavailable; record noise changes, not query execution.
historical_identity: Binary predictive target, not identification of a human belief/constraint/order history.
